description: Defines the TestCookieAccessDelegate class used for testing cookie access semantics, including setting expectations for cookie domains, handling first-party sets, and callback behavior.

classes.name: TestCookieAccessDelegate
classes.description: A test implementation of CookieAccessDelegate for controlling cookie access semantics and first-party set behavior during testing.

methods.name: SetExpectationForCookieDomain
methods.description: Sets the expected CookieAccessSemantics for cookies matching a specific domain.

methods.name: SetIgnoreSameSiteRestrictionsScheme
methods.description: Configures schemes that should always attach SameSite cookies, optionally requiring secure origins.

methods.name: SetFirstPartySets
methods.description: Defines the first-party sets used in testing, mapping sites to their set entries.

methods.name: set_invoke_callbacks_asynchronously
methods.description: Sets whether callbacks should be invoked asynchronously.
